registries.name: Artifact Hub
registries.focus: Helm charts, operators and policy packs

Integrity rules: Do not treat code repository as a deployed server
Never execute scanned packages during discovery
Require license check, security review, maintenance review before import
Identify direct Worker compatibility before deployment

cloudflare_fit_legend.potential_direct: Candidate only. Verify Workers APIs and compatibility
cloudflare_fit_legend.runtime_specific: Can require WASM compiling or adaptation
cloudflare_fit_legend.bridge_or_port: May run via a Worker front end and external runtime
cloudflare_fit_legend.external_compute: Generally needs containers/VM/Kubernetes or provider compute
cloudflare_fit_legend.not_worker: A kernel/OS is not installable as a Cloudflare Worker
